welcome: From first idea to final call.
title: Project title
emptyHint: Create your first project and start writing.
tip: Start with a scene heading, describe what we see and hear, then add characters.
deleteConfirm: Delete this project and its local backup?
boardEmpty: Add an image for your visual references.
storyHelp: Add visual cards, reorder them, and print the storyboard or save it as PDF.
breakdownHint: Track production elements by scene and review what still needs attention.
autoFromScript: Use the script as a starting point; review and complete production details yourself.
shotlistHint: Add shots and record image, framing, movement, lens, sound, and timing.
shortlistHint: Select scenes, shots, cast, locations, and equipment for this list.
taskHint: Track who is handling each action and when it is due.
dayAssignment: Select scenes for this shoot day
removeDayConfirm: Remove this shoot day and its scene assignments?
callReview: Review times, contacts, and safety information before sharing this call sheet.
productionIntro: Build shoot days, track production actions, and prepare the set.
moodboardHint: Collect images, notes, and colors for the visual direction.
storyboardHint: Develop scenes into visual cards with framing, movement, sound, and duration.
castCrewHint: Assign people to shoot days and set their availability for each day. Contact details print only when you enable them.
castCrewEmpty: No cast or crew members have been added yet.
restoreRevisionConfirm: Restore this revision? Save the current text as a revision first if you want to keep it.
noRevisions: No revisions have been saved yet.
autoRevisionNote: Automatically saved before restoring another revision.
dayLocked: Approved and locked. Unlock this shoot day to make changes.
backupHelp: Review, compare, and restore saved versions. Compare any two valid automatic snapshots or recovery points. Up to ten automatic snapshots are retained; older ones rotate out. Restoring saves the current version as a recovery point.
restoreBackupConfirm: Restore this backup? The current project version will first be saved as a recovery point.
noBackupsHint: The previous project version will appear here after a later save.
safetyLogisticsHint: This information prints on the call sheet. Enter weather manually or fetch a forecast on request; your town or postal code and shoot date are then sent to Open-Meteo.

safetyPlanHint: Measures, responsible person, and assembly point
cateringHint: Meal times, allergies, and dietary requirements
weatherHint: Enter the source and time of the latest check
weatherPlanHint: Interior location, delay, or other adjustment
timelineHint: Add activities with a start time and estimated duration. Check overlap and wrap warnings.
scheduleSuggestHint: Scenes are grouped by location and start at the call time. Enter a separate estimated shoot duration for each scene; script runtime is not used as shoot time.
scheduleSuggestReview: This replaces the current day schedule. Review cast availability, travel, setup, breaks, and wrap before sharing or locking the day.
scheduleNeedsCall: Set a valid call time before creating a timed proposal.
scheduleDurationsRequired: Enter a positive estimated shoot duration for every scene.
scheduleNoScenes: Assign at least one scene to this shoot day first.
scheduleTravelRequired: Enter a default when a destination has no numeric travel estimate; enter 0 when no move is needed.
scheduleBreakRequired: Enter the estimated duration for the scheduled break.
timelineOverrun: One or more items end after the expected wrap.
projectImportedImagesNote: Project imported. Some images were missing from the file; add them again.
projectExportedImagesNote: Project exported. Some image files could not be bundled and must be added again after import.
projectImagesLimit: A project export can contain up to 28 MB of images.
textSizeHint: Enlarge the interface for comfortable reading; this preference applies to this app.
writingTipHint: Show or hide the contextual starter tip in the script editor.
showIntroAgainHint: Review the introduction whenever you need it.
fountainNoScenes: No recognizable scene headings found. Use INT., EXT., INT./EXT., or EXT./INT.
fountainUnlockDays: Unlock all locked shoot days and scenes before importing another script.
fountainImportConfirm: This replaces all current scenes. Scene links in shoot days, shots, shortlists, and storyboards will be cleared; shot records stay in place. Multiple character and dialogue blocks per scene remain structured. Revision colors and revision-round details are not imported. Continue?
fountainImportedFlattened: Fountain script imported. {n} extra dialogue block(s) were kept as action text.

introBody: Takevera stores your projects locally. Start with a blank project or open the sample.
introStepOne: Create a project and choose its production type and script language.
introStepTwo: Write scenes; extra script blocks adapt to your production.
introStepThree: Use Production for shoot days, call sheets, shots, and tasks.
introOffline: Your project stays on this device. AI and sync are not needed to write.
sceneCommentsHint: Notes for this scene. Comments stay local unless live collaboration is connected.
aiConfigurationHint: Use a local model server or your own OpenAI-compatible API. Nothing is sent until you request and confirm a suggestion in the editor.
modelHint: For example, a model name from your provider
apiKeySaved: Key saved; leave blank to keep it
secureKeyStorage: Key encrypted in system secure storage
aiPrivacy: Only the context previewed for the selected AI task is sent after your consent. Check the provider’s terms and costs.
localPrivacy: Projects stay local. The app sends no data to a server unless you confirm an optional AI request.
configureAIFirst: Configure an AI endpoint and model in Settings first.
aiInstructionsHint: For example, specify tone, style, length, or language…
dataSentToProvider: Review the text that will be sent
aiContextNotice: The selected task, the project information shown below, and your instruction will be sent to the chosen provider when you confirm this request.
aiConsent: I reviewed the displayed text and authorize this request.
aiOriginalUnchanged: Nothing is applied automatically. Edit and save the suggestion separately, or deliberately add a scene-level suggestion as a separate script block.
suggestionSaved: Suggestion saved as a separate block.
inventoryHint: Track items by scene, assign an owner, and update their status.
manualFromScript: Use the script as a starting point; review and complete production details yourself.
syncHelp: Choose a shared folder on a network drive or sync service. Sync only runs when you start it here.
syncImportBody: Choose a project to import as a new local project.
syncCurrentHelp: Check the project version first and choose which version to keep if there is a conflict.
syncLimits: This syncs files; it is not live co-editing. Other users need access to the same folder. Make regular backups.
syncConfirm: This project and its linked images will be written to the shared folder. Continue?
syncCurrent: Project is already up to date.
syncConflictBody: Both the shared and local versions contain changes. Choose which version to keep. Shared version updated:
syncLocalApplied: Local version written to the shared folder.
syncErrorLocalSafe: Sync failed; local version is preserved
fdxInvalid: This file is not valid Final Draft XML.
fdxNoScenes: No scene headings were found in the FDX file.
fdxImportConfirm: Scenes will be replaced by the FDX contents. A script revision is saved first; links to shoot days, shots, shortlists, and storyboards will be cleared. FDX revision sets and active text marks are imported. Continue?
fdxExportConfirm: The FDX file contains script text and active revision marks. Production data, comments, and complete script history do not fit the standard format. You can optionally save that data as a separate Takevera project file. Continue?
docxInvalid: The Word document does not contain a readable document structure.
docxNoText: The Word document contains no text.
docxImportConfirm: Scenes in this project will be replaced by the DOCX text. A script revision is saved first; links to shoot days, shots, shortlists, and storyboards will be cleared. Revision colors and round metadata from ordinary Word files are not imported. Continue?
docxExportConfirm: The visible Word pages contain the script and basic styles. Images are not embedded, and complex Word formatting or revision history is not fully preserved. Continue to choose whether to include additional Takevera project data?
pdfInvalid: The PDF could not be read.
pdfNoText: No usable text found. Scans can be recognized locally with Apple Vision OCR on macOS with the Swift command-line tools.
pdfImportWarning: PDF layout is converted to plain script text. Dialogue, pagination, comments, and revision information are not identified. Review the preview before replacing the current scenes.
deleteMoodboardConfirm: Delete this moodboard and all its items?
callSheetIncludeContacts: Include contact and emergency details (phone numbers only with consent)
callSheetConfirm: Have you checked the date, times, locations, contact details, and safety information before sharing or saving this call sheet?
sceneReferencesEmpty: Add images or visual references to this scene.
imageRightsHint: Record the source, creator, and usage rights; confirm you are allowed to use the image.
templateSectionsHint: Choose which shoot-day and project-wide sections to include. Use the arrows to change the order within each group.
customBookSectionsHint: Add your own text sections to the production book.
productionBookConfirm: Have you checked the contents, version, and sensitive contact details before sharing or saving this production book?
collaborationHelp: Use an invitation from a self-hosted Takevera server. Project content and scene comments are sent to that server only after you connect.
collaborationTokenHint: Paste the token supplied by the project owner
collaborationPrivacy: A local recovery backup is created before connecting. WSS is required for remote servers.
collaborationConfirm: Connect “{title}” to {url}? Project content and scene comments will be shared with this server.
budgetHint: Track estimated and actual production costs by category and owner. Totals are planning figures, not accounting advice.
revisionColorPrintHint: Printed page colors depend on the print dialog’s background graphics setting. Check the PDF before sharing.
revisionPrintConfirm: This script contains revision-color pages. Enable background graphics in the print dialog if you need the colors in the PDF. Continue?
commentAnchorStale: The text has moved or changed since this note was added
commentAnchorUnavailable: The original text anchor can no longer be found.
projectSearchPlaceholder: Search script, bible, and production data…
projectSearchHint: Search this project’s script, bible, production data, and boards.
projectSearchShortcut: Press Esc to close · ⌘F / Ctrl+F opens project search
weatherLocationHint: Town or postal code, not a street address
weatherLocationRequired: Enter a town or postal code first.
weatherNetworkConsent: The location “{location}” and shoot date {date} will be sent to Open-Meteo to retrieve a forecast and astronomical sunrise, sunset, and daylight duration. Use a town or postal code only, not a street address. The free API is for non-commercial use only; check licensing for your production. Continue?
weatherSourceHint: Manual weather and daylight entry remain available. A fetched forecast includes its source, forecast date, and retrieval time; sunrise, sunset, and daylight duration are astronomical estimates. Weather data are Open-Meteo CC BY 4.0.
weatherLocationNotFound: No matching location found. Check the town or postal code.
weatherForecastUnavailable: No forecast is available for this date. Forecasts extend up to 16 days ahead.
weatherNetworkError: Check your internet connection and try again.
scriptPrintFormatHint: Per project: choose paper size and Courier font size for script and PDF.
spellcheckHelp: Check script text in the project language. Right-click for suggestions; added words are stored in your local dictionary. On Windows/Linux, a missing dictionary may be downloaded.
imageDropLocked: Unlock this scene or shoot day before adding images.
imageStorageMessage: How would you like to store this image?
imageStorageHint: Linked images remain at their current location.
pdfOCRPages: {n} page(s) recognized locally with Apple Vision OCR.
sceneLightHint: Sources, positions, modifiers, power and safety
sceneSoundHint: Microphones, recording settings, ambience and wild tracks
sceneNavigationHint: Use the up and down arrow keys to move between scenes. Home and End move to the first or last visible scene.
scriptCustomLayoutHint: Set page margins, extra text margins, indents, and line spacing. Extra text margins are added inside the page margins.
glossaryHint: Short explanations of common script and production terms.

glossaryTerms.definition: The first line of a scene. In film it usually names interior or exterior, the location, and time of day.
What the audience can see or hear. Describe observable events in the present tense.
The name above a dialogue line that identifies the speaker.
The spoken words of a character or speaker.
A short instruction for acting, movement, staging, or performance.
A scene-by-scene list of props, costumes, equipment, sound, and other production needs.
Details that must stay consistent between scenes, such as wardrobe, objects, or action order.
A list of planned camera shots, framing, movement, sound, and notes.
The day plan for cast and crew, including call times, location, scenes, and practical information.
Separately recorded ambient sound without dialogue or visible action, used in editing.
A dated script version with change notes. Productions often use a color to identify revised pages.
A personal or shared selection of scenes, shots, cast, locations, or equipment.

docxEmbeddedImportConfirm: This DOCX also contains a Takevera project snapshot. OK creates a new project with the DOCX script text and the saved production data and revisions. Image files themselves are not included. Cancel imports only the script into the current project.
docxEmbeddedImported: DOCX project with production data imported.
fdxEmbeddedImportConfirm: A Takevera project file is also next to this FDX. OK creates a new project using the FDX script text and the production data and revisions from that file. Image files are not included. Cancel imports only the script into the current project.
fdxExportSidecarConfirm: Would you also like to save a Takevera project file beside the FDX script? It contains production data, comments, revisions, and local image references. This separate file is needed to import that data later; share it deliberately.
fdxExportedWithSidecar: FDX script and project file exported.
fdxExportedNoSidecar: FDX script exported; the project file was not saved.
embeddedProjectInvalid: The Takevera project file is invalid or damaged.
scanScriptReferences: Find characters and locations in script
derivedReferenceReview: Candidates come from scene headings, character cues, and explicit music or sound cues. Review the selection before adding; new entries stay marked until you verify them.
noScriptReferencesFound: No character cues or locations were found to review.
derivedReferencesSaved: Script references updated. Review the new entries in the project bible and scene breakdown.
storageMoveHint: Choose a parent folder; Takevera uses a Takevera folder inside it. The current folder stays as a rollback copy.
storageMoved: Project storage now uses {path}. The previous copy remains at {previousPath}. Keep it until you verify the new copy.
adminIntro: Manage invitations, review access events, and set audit-log retention. Project content stays on your server.
adminTokenHelp: Paste the temporary token printed in the terminal where this admin service was started. It is kept in memory only.
adminRetentionHint: Choose how many days of server access events to keep (1–3650 days).
adminTokenOnce: Copy it now. The token is not stored in plaintext and cannot be shown again.
adminSecurityNote: This admin service listens only on 127.0.0.1. Keep its temporary token private.
adminCopyFailed: Could not copy the token. Select and copy it manually.
reportEmpty: There is no information for this section yet.
reportConfirm: Have you checked {report}, the version, and any contact details before sharing or saving this export?
collabAdminDesktop: Manage invitations and roles in Takevera
collabAdminDesktopHelp: Connect to the temporary admin service on this device to create and revoke invitations for the open project. Start the localhost admin service and paste its terminal token below.
collabAdminTokenHelp: The token is sent only to 127.0.0.1 and stored with system secure storage when available.
collabAdminTokenPlaceholder: Paste the temporary localhost admin token
aiProjectContinuity: Check continuity across the full script
aiProductionBreakdown: Suggest production data from the script

aiNoSavedSuggestions: No AI suggestions have been saved yet.
fdxEmbeddedImported: FDX script, production data, comments, and revisions were imported into a new project.

scheduleBufferInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 240 minutes.

homeTagline: Write, plan and make room for stories.

interfaceLanguageHint: Changes the interface, not your script language.

daylightHint: For example, record sunrise, sunset, or golden hour.
